complete_examples.text: They are solved using the Newmark-β integral method with a time step size Δt of 0.0001 s, while the multi-time step size nΔt for solving the PCPSI system is 0.0003 s. The excitation of the dynamic system, i.e., the track irregularity, is converted using the Fourier trans form method applied to the Chinese HSR spectrum [40] (1–50 m wavelength) and the Sato spectrum [41] (0.05–1 m wavelength).
